verdict.rationale: Metronome documents sending sandbox and production data directly to your data warehouse, and offers paginated list endpoints, such as listing customer contracts. That gives a credible bulk-export path for billing data. Nothing in the evidence covers porting stored payment methods to another provider. Payment collection appears to be delegated to Stripe invoices, but the pack never says this makes payment methods portable. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that subscriptions, invoices and usage events are all included in the export, a documented payment-method portability or migration path, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full exit export.
